title: 20-year monthly ocean pH observations and secular decline
what: Southern Ocean secular decline per decade (~-0.027 pH/decade), 20-yr drop (~0.054), or all-station mean rate

reader_questions.question: What is the primary quantitative finding or value?
reader_questions.expected: Southern Ocean declines fastest at -0.026 pH/decade (~0.051 pH over 20 years).

reader_questions.question: Is the difference clearly outside uncertainty or noise?
reader_questions.expected: Yes; despite the ±0.02 seasonal oscillation, the 20-year secular downward trend is clear at all three stations.

reader_questions.question: What caveat, outlier, control, or subgroup pattern matters?
reader_questions.expected: Seasonal amplitude (~±0.024 pH in the Southern Ocean) is comparable to a full decade of secular acidification.
